EASTMAN CHEMICAL COMPANY - EMN Item 2.02 Results of Operations and Financial Condition On April 30, 2026, the registrant publicly released its financial results for first quarter 2026. The full text of the release is furnished as Exhibit 99.01 to this Current Report on Form 8-K, and is incorporated herein by reference. This information shall not be deemed "filed" for purposes of Section 18 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended (the "Exchange Act"), or incorporated by reference in any filing under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, or the Exchange Act, except as shall be expressly set forth by specific reference in such a filing. Item 9.01 Financial Statements and Exhibits: (d) Exhibits The following exhibits are furnished pursuant to Item 9.01:
99.01 Public release by Eastman on April 30, 2026 of first quarter 2026 financial results
